items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Well okay, well if you'd contact Mrs. Alice Justin at 1429 Domaine Street.

ctx.x: Well yes, if you might put it on here.
Well okay, well if you'd contact Mrs. Alice Justin at 1429 Domaine Street. Oh yes. It's right across the street from the old San Jacinto Club.
I recorded there. I recorded George Lewis and Buck Johnson. Oh did you? Yes, in 1944. I recorded there one whole week, six nights. Oh, that used to be quite a spot.
